lessons.title: Read the working system

experiment.summary: Trace an inspect-only goal and compare its completion gates with an application goal.
experiment.safe_boundary: Use the synthetic store and existing interfaces; change no application code.

lessons.l1_prompt: Trace one validated job through the modules and identify the first human-review boundary.
lessons.l2_prompt: Explain why one modular Python application is appropriate here and when a queue or service split would become necessary.

lessons.title: JSON is input, not a contract

experiment.summary: In an isolated input fixture, compare max_calls=8 with true, a numeric string, and a blank skill.
experiment.safe_boundary: Create an ignored .lab/experiments input copy; do not change the working Job contract or committed fixture.

lessons.l1_prompt: Explain the Python objects created by JSON decoding and why Boolean-as-integer needs a strict boundary.
lessons.l2_prompt: Defend strict validation versus coercion and explain how a versioned API schema could evolve safely.

lessons.title: Proposals do not grant permission

experiment.summary: Propose an unknown tool and inspect rejection before any provider effect.
experiment.safe_boundary: Use an injected planner in a standalone experiment/test with a temporary store, never a shell or browser tool.

lessons.l1_prompt: Trace a tool proposal through name, permission, schema, budget and execution checks.
lessons.l2_prompt: Compare this plan-and-execute design with routing, ReAct and an ordinary script without claiming all patterns are implemented.

lessons.title: Review, receipts and recovery

experiment.summary: Inject effect-success/response-timeout, restart the engine, and reconcile the same action.
experiment.safe_boundary: Use FakeProvider and a fresh temporary directory; preserve the first receipt and exact payload.

lessons.l1_prompt: Explain what survives a process failure and why an unknown outcome must be reconciled before retry.
lessons.l2_prompt: Explain the limits of provider idempotency, approval binding and transaction boundaries across independent stores.

lessons.title: Knowledge is versioned evidence

experiment.summary: In a synthetic record copy, introduce a newer revoked version and inspect the selected corpus.
experiment.safe_boundary: Only synthetic lab records are editable; imported real snapshots remain read-only and outside Git.

lessons.l1_prompt: Distinguish a source record version, snapshot revision, source hash, export hash and action approval.
lessons.l2_prompt: Explain optimistic concurrency and why a reporting projection must be verified separately from event storage.

lessons.title: Ingest and chunk without losing provenance

experiment.summary: Change a synthetic record version/text and compare its chunk IDs and source metadata.
experiment.safe_boundary: Use a copied synthetic fixture or an in-memory dictionary; do not index generated drafts, practice answers or evaluation labels.

lessons.l1_prompt: Trace a native record through selection and chunking while naming each preserved field.
lessons.l2_prompt: Compare chunk size, update semantics and provenance granularity for a small evidence store versus a large corpus.

lessons.title: Similarity is a candidate signal

experiment.summary: Compare top-k, a metadata filter and a stricter relevance threshold on a development query.
experiment.safe_boundary: Keep held-out labels unchanged and outside the index; never relabel hash vectors as semantic embeddings.

lessons.l1_prompt: Explain filtering versus ranking and why a nearest result can still be irrelevant.
lessons.l2_prompt: Defend model, threshold, refresh and hosting choices using calibration evidence, memory and cold-start constraints.

lessons.title: Bound context, then validate the answer

experiment.summary: Shrink the context budget until one whole source no longer fits and test that it cannot be cited.
experiment.safe_boundary: Change only an experiment parameter; use retained context IDs, never all retrieved IDs, for generation and validation.

lessons.l1_prompt: Distinguish retrieved chunks, retained context, citation membership, accurate quotation and semantic support.
lessons.l2_prompt: Design a conservative token budget and claim-support evaluation without treating temperature zero or valid JSON as truth.

lessons.title: Measure the system and the learner separately

experiment.summary: Shuffle evaluation rows and remove one case; compare by stable case ID and inspect missing-case reporting.
experiment.safe_boundary: Use a copied score list. Do not change held-out labels, create personal scores from test passes, or invent timings.

lessons.l1_prompt: State the numerator and denominator for retrieval recall, citation validity, support and abstention.
lessons.l2_prompt: Propose a release gate that accounts for sample coverage, semantic limitations, missing cases and rollback.

lessons.title: Interfaces, packaging and future hosting

experiment.summary: Send a rejected request to an isolated API client and prove that storage/provider work did not occur.
experiment.safe_boundary: Use the test app and temporary store. Do not deploy, expose a public port or provision a service.

lessons.l1_prompt: Trace validation and authentication before mutation and explain how resources load from an installed wheel.
lessons.l2_prompt: Compare a private Codespace preview with a durable hosted service and explain MCP discovery versus a Python function registry.
